items.name: Introdução
items.content: {"json":"## Frontend · Requisições e latência\nEste painel apresenta as **requisições recebidas pelo servidor web quando instrumentado**. Chamadas iniciadas no navegador não aparecem automaticamente aqui. O workflow de benchmark Playwright mede quantidade de requests nas jornadas públicas sem coletar URLs privadas."}

items.name: Dados disponíveis do Frontend
items.content: {"json":"### Frontend · Logs do serviço web\nOs gráficos de console usam eventos reais do Container App em DEV. **Não medem o número de fetches enviados pelo navegador.** O benchmark no GitHub Actions fornece latência e disponibilidade de `/health`."}

items.name: Logs e anomalias do Frontend
items.content:
{"version":"KqlItem/1.0","query":"ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where tostring(column_ifexists("ContainerAppName_s","")) == "ca-coderats-base-web-dev"
| summarize EntradasLog=count(), IndicadoresErro=countif(Log_s has_any ("error","exception","failed")) by bin(TimeGenerated,1h)
| order by TimeGenerated asc","queryType":0,"resourceType":"microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces","resourceIds":["__LOG_ANALYTICS_WORKSPACE_ID__"],"visualization":"timechart","size":0,"timeContext":{"durationMs":86400000}}

items.name: Logs Frontend por intervalo
items.content:
{"version":"KqlItem/1.0","query":"ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where tostring(column_ifexists("ContainerAppName_s","")) == "ca-coderats-base-web-dev"
| summarize EntradasLog=count() by bin(TimeGenerated,15m)
| order by TimeGenerated asc","queryType":0,"resourceType":"microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces","resourceIds":["__LOG_ANALYTICS_WORKSPACE_ID__"],"visualization":"timechart","size":0,"timeContext":{"durationMs":86400000}}

items.name: Atividade por role
items.content:
{"version":"KqlItem/1.0","query":"AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| summarize Requests=count(), Falhas=countif(Success == false), P95_ms=round(percentile(DurationMs,95),1) by AppRoleName
| order by Requests desc","queryType":0,"resourceType":"microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces","resourceIds":["__LOG_ANALYTICS_WORKSPACE_ID__"],"visualization":"table","size":0,"timeContext":{"durationMs":86400000}}

items.name: Duração por rota
items.content:
{"version":"KqlItem/1.0","query":"AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| summarize Requests=count(), P95_ms=round(percentile(DurationMs,95),1) by AppRoleName, Name
| top 30 by Requests desc","queryType":0,"resourceType":"microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces","resourceIds":["__LOG_ANALYTICS_WORKSPACE_ID__"],"visualization":"table","size":0,"timeContext":{"durationMs":86400000}}

items.name: Variação da carga
items.content:
{"version":"KqlItem/1.0","query":"AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| summarize Requests=count() by bin(TimeGenerated,1h), AppRoleName
| order by TimeGenerated asc","queryType":0,"resourceType":"microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces","resourceIds":["__LOG_ANALYTICS_WORKSPACE_ID__"],"visualization":"timechart","size":0,"timeContext":{"durationMs":86400000}}
